user.title: Hegel amplifier
user.description:
Enter the IP address or host name of your Hegel streaming amplifier. It must be on the same network as Home Assistant.

Brought to you by [HiFiSync]({hifisync_url}): hi-fi system matching grounded in physics.

data_description.host: For example 192.168.1.50. Reserve the address in your router so it does not change.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Hegel amplifier found
zeroconf_confirm.description:
Add {name} ({model}) at {host}?

Brought to you by [HiFiSync]({hifisync_url}): hi-fi system matching grounded in physics.

error.cannot_connect: The amplifier did not answer. Check the address and that the amp is powered at the mains (standby is fine).
error.not_hegel: A device answered, but it does not look like a Hegel streaming amplifier.

abort.already_configured: This amplifier is already set up.
abort.not_hegel: The discovered device is not a Hegel amplifier.
abort.wrong_device: A different amplifier answers at this address.

data_description.max_volume: Home Assistant never sets the volume above this, so a slipped slider cannot drive the amp to full power. The amp's own remote is not limited.

not_responding.message: The amplifier at {host} is not responding. It is switched off at the mains or disconnected; turn it on at the amp.

turned_off.message: The amplifier is turned off. Turn it on first.

unknown_source.message: This amplifier has no input called {source}.
